name: src/app.js
observations: Main entry point (1363 lines). Orchestrator that initializes all modules and manages the render loop.

Imports: store, StorageService, theme, i18n, geoService, DailyCards, DataProcessor, WeatherFetcher, weather, ChangelogModal, pwa, color, time, math, MetricsRenderer, AtmosphereRenderer, GridRenderer, BackgroundRenderer, StickmanRenderer, OverlayRenderer, MapSelector, FavoritesModal, YearInPixels, BottomSheet, ScrollIndicator, TopPanel, PullToRefresh, SpfModal, AlertEngine, TooltipManager, MinimapRenderer
Exports: none (self-executing via DOMContentLoaded listener).
Key functions: init() (28+ sub-functions), useMyLocation(), loadWeather(), toggleTheme(), render(), drawTile(), drawFixedOverlay(), handleResize(), centerOnCurrentTime(), updateNowButtonPosition().
Manages tile-based canvas rendering: tiles array, TILE_WIDTH dynamic (1440px desktop, 720px mobile <600px), PIXELS_PER_HOUR (60 desktop, 50 mobile).
Three canvas layers: main-canvas (tile canvases), fixed-overlay-canvas (scrubber labels/NOW/stickman), stickman-canvas (animated figure).
Scroll-driven rendering via requestAnimationFrame with buffer of ±1 tile.

Session completed: full memory graph rebuild. 49 module entities created with detailed observations of exports, imports, and key functions. 110+ import relations established. All 64 JS files in src/ accounted for.
Refactored from multi-tile canvas system (N tiles with alpha context, drawn flag, tile buffer) to single viewport-sized canvas that redraws completely on each render()
Removed: tiles array, TILE_WIDTH variable, drawTile() function, drawn flag, tile creation/destruction in handleResize()
Added: mainCanvas/mainCtx, canvas is reparented to #chart-area with position:absolute, sized to viewport with DPR scaling
render() now uses scrollContainer.scrollLeft as viewX and clientWidth as viewW, passes world coordinates to 16 draw functions
5 references to tiles removed: toggleTheme, initLanguage, initThemeSelector, initPullToRefresh, handleResize
Refactored from multi-canvas tiled rendering to single viewport-sized canvas (v1.11.0)
Removed tiles array, TILE_WIDTH, drawTile(), drawn flags
render() now clears and redraws all layers on single mainCanvas
Added mainCtx.translate(-viewX, 0) at line 977 for world-to-canvas coordinate mapping
Added offscreen canvas buffer (3× viewport width) for scroll performance - render() does single drawImage GPU blit on scroll, only redraws offscreen when scroll exits buffer range
Cached getComputedStyle in cachedStyles variable, updated only on theme change - eliminates forced synchronous layout on every scroll frame
Mali-G76 (Redmi Note 10S) fix v2: robust canvas clearing in drawTile() using clearRect + destination-out fill + source-over reset (L962-967)
Removed { alpha: true } from tile canvas creation in handleResize() to prevent alpha compositing artifacts on Mali-G76 (L1293)
Tile canvases now created without alpha channel to avoid Mali-G76 GPU compositing bug where alternating canvases show black backgrounds, opaque day names, opaque glow, and visible vertical divisions

name: architecture.data-flow
observations: Complete data flow: (1) app.init() → storageService.init() loads preferences from IndexedDB. (2) geoService obtains coordinates (geolocation or search). (3) fetchWeatherData() via WeatherFetcher → weatherService.getWeatherData(lat, lon, 7, 7) calls Open-Meteo forecast + AQI simultaneously. (4) processData() transforms raw data → state.hourlyData[] and state.dailyData[]. (5) processData generates daily cards and saves history via storageService.setHistory(). (6) scroll event → render() → iterates tiles → drawTile() for undrawn tiles. (7) Scroll also triggers updateTopPanel(), drawFixedOverlay(), updateMinimapViewport().
Fallback chain: API success → in-memory cache (5min TTL) → expired cache (stale* indicator) → MockData (when all fails).
All rendering goes through render() which only draws non-drawn tiles within viewport ±1 buffer.

name: architecture.canvas-layers
observations: Three-layer canvas system inside #chart-area in index.html: layer 1 = main-canvas (tile canvases for background/grid/weather/metrics), layer 2 = fixed-overlay-canvas (scrubber labels, NOW indicator, stickman, redrawn each scroll frame), layer 3 = stickman-canvas (animated stickman figure, updated via updateWeatherZone in OverlayRenderer).
Minimap has separate canvas (minimap-canvas) with its own cacheCanvas (drawn once, re-used via drawImage).
ALL main chart rendering goes through render() → drawTile(). Never draw to tile canvases outside this function.

name: architecture.tiling
observations: Tile-based rendering for performance. TILE_WIDTH = 1440px desktop, 720px mobile <600px (set dynamically in handleResize()). PIXELS_PER_HOUR = 60 desktop, 50 mobile.
numTiles = ceil(totalWidth / TILE_WIDTH) where totalWidth = hourlyData.length * PIXELS_PER_HOUR.
Tiles array stores {canvas, ctx, index, drawn} objects. Only visible tiles in viewport range are drawn; off-screen tiles skipped via drawn flag.
render() loop: for each tile in [startTile, endTile], if !tile.drawn then drawTile(tile). Buffer of ±1 tile prevents blank areas.
Tile recreation on resize: old tiles removed, new tiles created with correct dimensions.

name: architecture.minimap
observations: Minimap has dedicated canvas (minimap-canvas) and cacheCanvas for performance. Managed by MinimapRenderer class.
Dual-mode operation: 'past' (historical data with dark overlay) and 'future' (forecast). Auto-switches when viewport center crosses current-time split index.
Rendered content: day/night background, date labels, zero line, cloud cover area, precipitation bars, probability line, temperature line, UV segments, NOW indicator with red glow.
Cache pattern: draw() renders to cacheCanvas first, then draws cache to visible canvas via drawImage. Cache invalidated via invalidateCache() when data/theme changes.
Click/drag: handleClick maps canvas position to scroll position. Drag via isDragging flag on mouse/touch events in app.js.

name: Redmi Note 10S Mali-G76 bug
observations: Type: GPU driver compositing bug
Affected device: Redmi Note 10S (MediaTek Helio G95, Mali-G76 MC4, Android 13)
Symptoms: night background shows black, day names opaque, temperature glow opaque, visible canvas seams on alternating tiles
Root cause: clearRect() fails to clear canvas to transparent on Mali-G76 when alpha channel context is used
Fix: destination-out compositing for guaranteed transparency + remove { alpha: true } from getContext + explicit source-over reset
Spec: specs/app.md documents the bug and fix
Version: fixed in v1.10.0c
Fix v1 (v1.10.0c) con destination-out alpha workaround NO funcionó — hipótesis incorrecta
Fix v2 (v1.10.0d): causa raíz real es GPU layer composition en Mali-G76 — CSS will-change:transform + transform-style:preserve-3d en tiles crea costuras entre capas 3D adyacentes

Fix v2 aplicado: CSS 3D props solo en fixed-overlay-canvas; tile canvases con will-change:auto + transform-style:flat + image-rendering:pixelated; canvas-wrapper con translateZ(0) como única capa GPU; overlap 1px entre tiles como seguridad extra

Fix v3 (v1.10.0e): forzado software rendering en tile canvases via getContext('2d', { willReadFrequently: true }) para bypassear pipeline GPU de Mali-G76. Revertido overlap 1px. Añadido snap scroll a entero en touchend/mouseup/scrollend. image-rendering: pixelated → auto. Ambos fixes previos (v1.10.0c alpha compositing, v1.10.0d CSS/overlap) superseded.
